designSummary: GRAD11_V2 ASTEROID FORGE. New clean canonical Unity scene. FULL industrial/crystal/asteroid structure in Layer0 only. 4-player open vertical lanes, diggable small galleries, separate MY hangar and shooter towers. All Layer0 decoration uses CURRENT 24 static project sprites; clips handled as explicit animation follow-up (not a level-schema feature). No wave/asteroid enemies here. All km axis values are authoring; runtime uses speed=1.2.

segments.designIntent: Rocky mouth, diggable gallery, open upper and lower flight channels
segments.playerRoutingIntent: Four-player arena: fly above or below local short obstacles, continuous passage and reconnection, leave 10+ world units of clear vertical maneuvering in view.
segments.geometryBrief: Native collidable SpriteShape floor and ceiling as physical limits; all inserted visual sprites are non-colliding environment decorations, tunnels are destructible prefab grid.
segments.enemyRoleBrief: Only stationary MY tower prefabs in Level Builder; wave agents/asteroids later via Reverse Waves.
segments.waveRhythmBrief: Reserved for later wave phase; 1 km/second regardless of level scroll speed.
segments.fourPlayerSafetyRules: No full-height tunnel barrier; two vertical approaches; visible core and catwalks cannot obstruct one another's collision path.
segments.designerNotes: Builder one-time handoff with 30% Inspector-only polish.
